# Session script: the recognition ritual (free call → reflection → the $555 2-hour session)

*Canonical template, synthesized 2026-10-27 by Evolver from six tellings (Genealogy at the end). It holds the whole path one person walks with Sasha, from the first booked call to the paid 2-hour session and its close. Where tellings differ, the newest Sasha-confirmed one wins (Sasha's decisions of 2026-10-27 on the entry door and the name; before them Funnel v5, 2026-10-19, and the live `/ignite` page); older claims stay as dated notes. The minute plan in §5 is a composition of the sources, marked as such, for Sasha to confirm on the next session.*

## 1. Essence
"The diagnosis IS the demo." The free call opens the gap in the person's own words; the same-day reflection connects the dots; the paid session closes them. **Listen. Name. Act.**

## 3. Three principles (hold them, never teach them)
1. **They're already doing it.** The business exists in the help they give for free and what people thank them for. You name, you don't invent.
2. **Scatter is active avoidance, not confusion.** They sense the answer but simplicity triggers identity terror; each pivot was a fragment (a third of who they are) of one whole.
3. **The first draft is the hook.** Seeing the whole canvas at ~6–7 creates the desire for 9.5+ ("The precision gap IS the product").

## 4. The path, end to end

### 4.1 Before the call (pre-call protocol)
- After booking, two questions in-channel: *"What's the transition you're in? And what have you tried?"*
- Optional free assessment before the call, framed as a gift, never required: "most people do it; the call goes deeper." Warm Zone-of-Genius alumni: invite a re-take (the current version is stronger).
- Never require full onboarding pre-call. Teens: no pre-work.
- Read whatever lead sheet exists (matchmaker profile, LinkedIn reading) as a **lead sheet, not a read**: verify anything load-bearing in the room.
- **Choose and declare the container** before the call starts (below).

### 4.2 The free call
**Entry door, now** (Sasha's decision, 2026-10-27): the free **45-minute Direction Call** on `/ignite` (cal.com/aleksandrkonstantinov/direction-choice-call), plus the **webinar**.
> *Dated note:* Funnel v5 (Sasha, 2026-10-19) made a free **20-minute call** the front door ("We get acquainted and Sasha reveals the cards: on the infographic, how this ability turns into a product"; cal.com/aleksandrkonstantinov/20), with the person's uniqueness sentence read in advance from their profile. From 2026-10-27 it is no longer the entry door. The fork "two free doors" (20 min vs 45 min) is closed by that decision.

**The Direction Call script** (2026-07, 7 stages, one emotional arc):
| Time | Stage | Emotion | Exact line |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0–3 | Frame | Safe | "These 45 minutes are fully yours. At the end I'll name what I see and one next step, and you're free either way." |
| 3–15 | Their field | Seen | "What's the transition you're in? And what have you tried?" |
| 15–18 | The cost | Stirred | "What has all that trying cost you so far?" |
| 18–30 | The mirror | **Struck** | "Can I say back the one thread I hear under all of it?" |
| 30–40 | Empowerment | Free | "What are you seeing right now?" then "What would having that answer change for you?" |
| 40–45 | The doors | Free | Pitch paragraph + "Both doors are genuinely fine with me", then silence. If yes-energy: "if you're ready, let's set it up right now." |

- **Struck, not relieved.** Stage 4 is the first clear sight of the gap. Relief belongs to the paid session.
- **Two containers** (v1.1, 2026-07-23): strangers get 45 hard minutes, doors at minute 40; peer-caliber warm calls get a declared 90-minute exploration ("at that altitude the depth IS the demonstration").
- **The three collapses:** stage 2 creates Attention, stage 3 Pain (in their voice), stage 6 tests Purchasing Power.
- **Incepting question per segment** (polymath, practitioner, founder between ventures, founder with live business, employee, fractional, community leader, investor, teen): see Distribution Playbook, Sales §3. Each asks them to articulate the invariant they can't yet.
- **Buying questions:** never answer with an explanation; point: "what you just asked is exactly the work."
- *Dated:* **the 20-minute version** (Funnel v5 door, not the entry door since 2026-10-27) compressed the same arc: frame → their field → the mirror (the reading and the infographic) → one door. *(Composition, never written by Sasha.)*

### 4.3 Same day: the Reflection Proposal
Built ONLY from their own words: (1) their invariant quoted back ("you said X, that is your pattern"); (2) their buying question quoted back; (3) their project's core derived from their own material; then ONE door with the price. Give the seed generously; sell the operationalization. «Диагностика бесплатно. Сборка за деньги.» "The mirror is free. The forge is paid."

### 4.4 The paid session: 2 hours
**Container required:** money paid (skin in the game) + human presence + the weight of the moment. Without it "the truth stays general and Möbius-invisible."

**Proposed minute plan** *(composition of v1 + v2 + the live page; Sasha to confirm after the next session)*:
| Time | Phase | What happens | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0–10 | Open | Open with their own words from the reflection message (the gap they saw on the call). Frame: "this is the process I went through myself." | 4a, v1 |
| 10–25 | Two questions | 1. "What do you desire most, professionally?" 2. "Where are you most stuck?" **Path A** (they can answer): the business is in the answer → "You just told me what it is. Listen to what you said." **Path B** (they can't): uniqueness extraction: "Who got the MOST value from you?", "What do people thank you for?", "What's so easy for you it feels like nothing?"; if still stuck, the site tools (Zone of Genius, Genius Business / Excalibur, Product Builder); then back to the two questions | v1, Mirror Session |
| 25–50 | Name the gift → the shadow | One sentence: "You are the person who [X]." Iterate to 9+/10 by their gut, then the recognition line: A "does it feel like something you've always known but never said?", B "where in the body did it land, what moved?", C "does it feel too simple?" (all three asked). Watch for "that's too simple / everyone can do that" → name it gently: "the thing you do most naturally feels too simple to be valuable; that's structural, not true." Predict the shadow internally (Vision → "I feel lost"; Building → "Nothing's finished"; Connection → "I feel isolated"; Focusing → "I can't see my own"). **The shadow landing is the peak** (Ogi: "that's an 11.23… a cold plunge") | v1, v2, proof case |
| 50–80 | AI drafts the canvas live | Feed the uniqueness into the protocol on screen: Myth (Master Lie / Master Belief) → Tribe (inner state, "name 3 people") → Pain (Point A) → Promise (Point B) → Value Ladder → first message. "Show it to them LIVE." | v2, v1 prompts as fallback |
| 80–100 | Recognition + refinement | Walk each artifact: "Does this land? What's off? What's missing?" Rate 1–10 by body, then the recognition line (A familiarity · B body · C "too simple"); low resonance may be resistance, not a wrong line. Log their exact words. Correct, regenerate. "Recognition, not learning." Then compress into the hero section: tagline, who it's for, what it does, why you | v2, `/ignite` |
| 100–115 | Act | Write the first message together for ONE named person and **send it in session** ("Who is the ONE person you'd send this to?") | v1 |
| 115–120 | Close | Next container in one sentence (see §4.5). If not: "You have your first offer. Go." | v1, v2 |

**What they leave with** (live `/ignite`, 2026-10-27): the "not-ready" loop named and cleared; purpose and mission in plain words; their lifelong pattern compressed into a one-sentence business; their magnetic story, a usable bio and the hero section of one landing page. **Guarantee:** none (Sasha, 2026-10-28); the former "or you don't pay" line was removed, since recognition can be blocked by the client's own resistance.
*Dated notes:* v1 deliverable was a sent first DM; Mirror Session: offer statement + first hand-raiser post draft; v2: full canvas first draft. All three survive inside the plan above.

### If-stuck cheat sheet
| Stuck at | Do |
|---|---|
| can't answer the two questions | Zone of Genius on the site; walk the 12 perspectives |
| gift named, no business form | Genius Business (Excalibur): gift → offer → form → pricing → channel |
| form but no specifics | Product Builder: result → sub-results → blueprint |
| myth won't crystallize | share Sasha's myth as an example: "Here's mine, what's YOURS?" |
| tribe too broad | "Name 3 people." Specific humans, not demographics |
| can't write the message | show Sasha's own DM: "same structure, your words" |

### DO / DON'T
| DO | DON'T |
|---|---|
| listen, reflect, name | teach theory or frameworks |
| use THEIR words | use playbook language |
| share your own journey as example | stand above them as the expert |
| make the act happen in session | leave it as homework |
| name the shadow gently | dig into it or do therapy |
| show excitement when truth emerges | stay clinical |
| name the lane early (business work vs inner work) | let ambiguity turn a client into a devotee |

### 4.5 The close and the ladder
- **Now** (Funnel v5, 2026-10-19): after the session, "Sasha offers to build it together in a group." From the webinar → Mastermind line (2026-10-23), the $555 session is also the natural next rung after the paid Mastermind.
- *Dated:* v1 offered a 3-week Sprint; v2 offered **The Build** with the precision-gap pitch ("This is iteration 1… Going through uniqueness at 9.9+ precision means every artifact downstream reaches that precision too"). The precision-gap logic still holds; the container name follows the current ladder.
- **Objections** (harvested 2026-07-24): use the ten handles in Distribution Playbook, Sales (e.g. "I already know myself" → from discovery to operationalization; "no money right now" → believe it, don't discount; "Interesting." → the gap was never opened in their words, return to eliciting).

## 5. After the session
- PULSE: update CRM / Offer Ledger the same day (Pulse Protocol).
- Ask for the moment on record: consent-gated clips per [testimonial-clips.md](./testimonial-clips.md).
- Post-call feedback on the recording with `scout-call-mirror` (speaking share, questions, hedges).
- Add what this session taught to this template (Meta-Template §7.4).

## 6. Open edges
- ~~Two free front doors (20 min vs 45 min)~~ closed 2026-10-27: the 45-min Direction Call plus the webinar, see §4.2.
- The 2-hour minute plan is a composition; Sasha has not run it as written.
- ~~Public name~~ closed 2026-10-27: **Founder-Market Fit Discovery Mastermind** (Sasha). The live `/ignite` tab, rail and video still carry the older names until the site is updated. Corrected 2026-10-28 (Sasha): Mastermind = the $222 group; this 1:1 = Founder-Market Fit session, $555.
